description: Bring up a self-implemented inference engine for official Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 on the local Apple M5 Pro (20 GPU cores, 48 GiB unified memory). Planned acceptance targets supplied by the user: prefill >= 500 tokens/s and decode >= 50 tokens/s, in addition to functional and correctness gates. No fixed budget; stop on user request. No candidate measurements have been obtained.
scope: New experiment on the local M5 Pro: bring up a self-implemented inference engine for the user-selected official FP8 checkpoint, with planned prefill >= 500 tokens/s and decode >= 50 tokens/s. Official model/weight discovery is delegated to the agent. The user set no fixed time, token, API cost, or hardware-hour cap and instructed the agent to stop on user request. Contract/evaluation stage gates remain in effect. A baseline may provide an independent reference; an existing inference-engine backend cannot serve as the candidate implementation. Operating-system changes and results publication have not been requested.

hardware.toolchain: Observed: .NET SDK 10.0.100 and 11.0.100-rc.1.26425.128 (osx-arm64); Apple clang 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2); Metal 4; Node.js v26.7.0 for planning checks. No project global.json exists yet. xcrun could not locate the offline Metal compiler; runtime Metal shader compilation is to be checked before freeze.
hardware.power: Observed AC power, battery charged; configured powermode=2 for AC and battery. No power settings modified; re-observe before each run.

target_model.weights: Official FP8 E4M3 checkpoint with 128x128 block scaling for quantized weights and BF16 tensors where excluded from quantization. Preserve this checkpoint representation; do not substitute affine INT8 or INT4. Activation, KV, and recurrent-state precision remain unresolved.

evaluation.warmup_plan: One complete warm-up pass of each selected repository-defined workload (--warmup 1), excluded from formal metrics. Run endpoint conformance first. Initial selected workloads are prefill.in2k.out1 and decode.in128.out256; retain the selection in result settings.

implementation.language_and_backend: User-selected .NET (C#) host with independently implemented Metal compute kernels for Apple Silicon. Implement weight loading, model execution, attention/recurrent state, and generation in the candidate; any native interop bridge must be limited to invoking Metal/platform APIs and must not wrap an existing LLM inference engine. SDK and binding package pins are resolved before freeze.

goal.primary_metric: Use the pinned engine-throughput headline workloads prefill.in2k.out1 and decode.in128.out256. Prefill throughput is processed uncached prompt tokens divided by client dispatch-to-first-output-chunk time, including queueing, transfer, and the first sampled token. Decode is the ratio of summed N-1 output-token intervals to summed first-to-last output-chunk durations, subject to the repository driver chunk-density gate. The 500/50 tokens/s values are planned acceptance targets, not measurements.
goal.quality_gate: Load the selected official FP8 model and generate through the independently implemented .NET + Metal inference path. Pass the pinned engine-api-conformance gate before throughput measurement. Apply the repository-owned workload length, usage, cache, and streaming gates and record every failed pass. Numerical equivalence to a reference implementation is not required by the updated protocol. HumanEval application scoring is a separately available evaluation, not selected in this initial throughput experiment.

Required experiment stage gates remain in effect; an unresolved prerequisite blocks dependent work. Report a completed functional outcome when its acceptance gates are met.
